currentArc: Ichigo is now fully awake and keeping a silent tally of his failed stealth missions.
runningGags: Teddy holding a catchment bowl for Ichigo's overambitious hoards.

episodes.title: A Matter of Capacity
episodes.summary: Ichigo overfilled her cheek pouches on the kitchen counter while Teddy waited quietly with an acorn cap for the inevitable overflow.

episodes.title: The Incline
episodes.summary: Teddy over-engineered a ramp to the sofa that Ichigo bypassed immediately.

episodes.title: Just Resting His Eyes
episodes.summary: Teddy insisted on staying up late for a midnight snack by the window, then promptly fell asleep mid-bite.

episodes.title: Thermal Efficiency
episodes.summary: Teddy treated Ichigo as a personal hot water bottle during an evening chill.

episodes.title: Almost Ready
episodes.summary: Ichigo waited with rigid punctuality by the door while Teddy took his sweet time grooming.

episodes.title: Just a Taste
episodes.summary: Ichigo claimed she wasn't hungry before eating directly from Teddy's saucer.

episodes.title: A Matter of Posture
episodes.summary: Teddy stubbornly crammed himself into an undersized saucer rather than admit he needed the big cushion Ichigo offered.

episodes.title: Just Hold This
episodes.summary: Teddy and Ichigo accidentally trapped each other into being immobile storage shelves during nest cleanup.

episodes.title: The Filing System
episodes.summary: Teddy spent the afternoon sorting their entire seed supply by diameter, dismantling Ichigo's intuitive foraging system.

episodes.title: Preemptive Portion
episodes.summary: Ichigo preemptively surrendered half a dried apple slice to Teddy before he could even ask.

episodes.title: The Loudest Quiet
episodes.summary: Ichigo silently rebuilt a fallen stack of buttons while Teddy sat frozen in guilt.

episodes.title: The Art of Stealth
episodes.summary: Teddy attempted a stealthy midnight snack run across the creaky floorboards and woke Ichigo anyway.
